subject: general
question: In which one of the following regions will you find "Bari Doab'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Between Beas and Ravi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bari Doab** is the region located **between the Beas and Ravi rivers**.
 
• The term "Doab" is derived from Persian, meaning "land between two rivers".
